title: Reporting Schedule Offering
description: Schedule constraint advertised by a seller. Unlike an installed reporting-schedule, an offering may resolve an account-specific upstream source timezone or let a billing-cycle configuration select its own anchor and IANA timezone.

period_anchor_policy.description: For billing_cycle only. fixed requires the advertised anchor and timezone; configurable lets each authorized account configuration select them.

period_timezone_policy.description: For source_timezone only. fixed advertises one exact upstream IANA timezone; account_resolved requires the seller to resolve and echo the account's upstream reporting timezone during configuration.

x-adcp-validation.installed_schedule_match: period_duration, alignment, and delivery_sla MUST equal the installed configuration. For fixed billing_cycle offerings, period_anchor and period_timezone MUST also equal it. For configurable billing_cycle offerings, the installed configuration supplies both values. A fixed source_timezone offering supplies period_timezone; an account_resolved source_timezone offering requires the seller to resolve and echo period_timezone before the configuration becomes ready. utc and account_timezone use the normative origins in reporting-schedule.json, so even multi-unit durations have one independently derivable phase.
x-adcp-validation.iana_timezone: Every advertised fixed period_timezone MUST be a recognized IANA Time Zone Database zone name or link, including UTC. Unknown identifiers and numeric UTC offsets are invalid.
x-adcp-validation.source_compatibility: The resolved schedule MUST be compatible with the pinned report definition calendar. A seller MUST NOT advertise or accept a schedule merely because it can query the source eventually; it must be able to produce the exact promised periods natively or through lossless finer-grained re-bucketing.
